correctness.rationale: For every finite poset and finite field, orthogonal joint spectral idempotents F_alpha constructed from any pairwise commuting idempotent tuple yield an explicit unit u=sum F_alpha D_alpha with diagonal one and e_j u=u D_j. This gives exactly one simultaneous-unit-conjugacy orbit per joint 0/1 diagonal coloring. Orbit-stabilizer counts (q-1)^n q^m units and (q-1)^n q^{m-d(c)} stabilizer units, giving q^{d(c)} tuples. Edge-subset expansion gives the Potts identity, including all field characteristics and n=1. The bundled directly enumerating convolution program agrees on chains/forks/diamonds/bipartite examples over F2,F3 at tuple lengths one to three; finite census is not relied upon for the all-parameter theorem.

originality.rationale: The checked primary incidence-monoid paper concerns a single idempotent orbit over the complex numbers, the finite-field potent-matrix paper enumerates one element at a time, and the triangular-ring commuting graph paper counts all-element edges in one matrix dimension. Those statements do not imply the orbit cardinalities and full ordered pairwise commuting k-tuple enumerator for arbitrary finite posets. Completed targeted scholarly and mathematical-record searches of tuple enumeration, simultaneous conjugation, equivalent Potts forms, stronger classifications, and exact tables returned no covering result. This is a bounded originality finding, not a proof of worldwide priority.

Sequence-database search was not exhaustive; small exact numeric tables could already be known.

value.rationale: Simultaneously commuting idempotents give finite Boolean projection systems, a natural structural invariant of incidence monoids and a genuine interaction problem absent from one-idempotent counts. A complete all-poset all-field all-length formula computes the whole spectrum, not a small arbitrary slice. The exact comparability-graph Potts identification proves invariance under transitive orientation and connects polynomial degree and leading coefficient to maximum multiway cuts. These are natural portable connections and classification facts, with explicit computational limitations.
